name.ja: ＲＥ/100 1/100 ガンイージ 陸戦タイプ（ブルーバード隊仕様）
name.en: RE/100 1/100 Gunigi land battle type (Bluebird Corps specification)

brands.ja: RE/100[リボーンワンハンドレッド]

description.ja: 『機動戦士Ｖガンダム ニューモビルスーツバリエーション』に登場した「ブルーバード隊」所属のガンイージ 陸戦タイプをＲＥ/100で立体化！
description.en: The Gunigi land battle type belonging to the "Bluebird Squad " that appeared in " Mobile Suit V Gundam New Mobile Suit Variation" is now three-dimensional with RE/100!

description.ja: アフリカ戦線を中心に活躍した機体の特徴的な本体カラーを成形色で再現。設定画稿に合わせた新規デザインの水転写式デカールが付属。
description.en: The characteristic body color of the aircraft that was active mainly on the African front is reproduced in molding color. A newly designed water transfer decal that matches the setting drawing is included.

description.ja: ●　設定画稿の機体色を忠実に再現！
description.en: ● Faithfully reproduces the aircraft color of the setting drawing!

description.ja: ＲＥ/100 ガンイージ 陸戦タイプをベースとして、「ブルーバード隊」の名の由来ともなった鮮やかなブルーを成形色にて再現。
description.en: Based on the RE/100 Gunigi land battle type, the bright blue color that gave rise to the name "Bluebird Corps" is reproduced in the molding color.

description.ja: また、肩部ダクトや膝部、各所カメラ類などにはシールを採用し、細部にわたり色分け再現。
description.en: In addition, Seal is used for the shoulder ducts, knees, and various cameras, and the details are reproduced in color.

description.ja: ●　新規デザインの水転写式デカールが付属！
description.en: ● Newly designed water transfer decal included!

description.ja: ブルーバード隊仕様機の特徴的な機体マーキングを新規デザインの水転写式デカールで再現。
description.en: The distinctive aircraft markings of the Bluebird Corps specification aircraft are reproduced with newly designed water transfer decals.

description.ja: ●　ガンイージの各種武装類が付属！
description.en: ● Various weapons of Gunigi are included!

description.ja: 豊富な武装類が付属し、多彩なポージングを再現可能。
description.en: A wide variety of weapons are included, allowing you to recreate a variety of poses.

description.ja: 付属武装：ビーム・ライフル　／　ビーム・サーベル ／ ビーム・バズーカ　／　ビーム・シールド
description.en: Attached weapons: Beam Rifle / Beam Saber / Beam Bazooka / Beam Seal
